::: {.callout-important title="Adjusted associations"}
Skill, mediator and dose coefficients describe relationships conditional on the model's listed covariates. They can remain confounded by unmeasured ability, measurement error and shared causes. Same-wave measurements do not establish temporal order. A child random intercept models repeated observations and stable residual differences; it does not by itself remove confounding. Describe these quantities as adjusted associations.
:::
